scope: Assisted source-eligibility, metadata, duplicate and evidence-depth review. This is not exhaustive full-document review, scientific peer review or experimental reproduction.

batch_reviews.description_policy: Every accepted relevance replaced with a short original purpose paraphrase. All evidence_excerpt fields removed. No quoted README prose, code, source URLs, prices or performance claims in relevance. Existing evidence hashes, timestamps, URLs, HTTP status and grades preserved.

batch_reviews.scope: Assisted description and relevance review, with targeted public README checks for ambiguous cases. No code execution, model calls, experimental reproduction or editorial_reviewed upgrade.

excluded.reason: Sampled task pack from an existing next-JEV choice training corpus; README describes planned teacher collection, without establishing new teacher-response supervision. Exclude conservatively as a subset/preparation artifact from the expansion count.

metadata_fixes.reason: Hosted in the Hub model namespace, but the linked resource is a training-loop implementation; its trained checkpoint is separately linked. Retain implementation-repository topic and do not count this as a released weight checkpoint.
The README identifies experiment code and separately links control/trained checkpoints; retain implementation-repository topic without implying Jev internals were reproduced.

scope_notes: Reviewed all titles, relevance descriptions and verification metadata; independently refetched 15 selected public READMEs and inspected relevant passages.
Language translations are labeled derivative resources retaining upstream labels; they do not create independent human gold labels.
Archived benchmark runs are distinct result artifacts, not newly independent benchmark test sets.
Prototype, experimental, retired and negative-result cards remain useful when those limits are preserved.
Technique Router is an adjacent request-to-action classifier for image processing; it is not represented as Jev-equivalent.
W1-JEV and flight-simulator performance remain publisher-reported; no numerical accuracy, cost or operational-suitability claims are endorsed.
For the two code repositories, hf_model accurately describes the Hub namespace only; recommended semantic artifact classification is hf_repository plus artifact_type.
batch_reviews.limitations: Card/body screening only. No model-weight or dataset-row downloads, benchmark execution, independent reproduction or upgrade to editorial_reviewed. Non-sampled rows received metadata/relevance review, not independent body refetch. Acceptance is conditional on the listed metadata clarifications.

limits: This is a conservative scope and identity review, not peer review or full-paper assessment.
Original provider abstracts were inspected from existing public-response caches; only selected DOI registrations and institutional pages were freshly fetched.
DOI-to-arXiv aliases were checked where indicated by metadata or title similarity; without all original OpenAlex locations, exhaustive alias resolution is not established.
Institutional theses and conference videos may be useful resources elsewhere; their exclusion here is a paper-batch scope decision.
Background labels remain background and are not evidence of Jev internals. Accepted records retain abstract_checked; no evidence tier is upgraded.
Per-topic relevance descriptions are coarse scope labels, not individual full-paper summaries.
